title: Eiyuu Shigan: Gal Act Heroism
overview:
Girls want adventure too!

A hilarious, slapstick new character-raising RPG about girls striving to become "heroes"!

Ayame, Luria and Mei are students at a school for adventurers, watched over by their guardian fairy Priscilla, and they have just begun a six-month training program. Roam the island around the school, take on requests and earn rewards as you work toward becoming full-fledged adventurers.

Every action uses up time, so plan carefully to raise the girls' abilities and clear requests before the deadline. Rival parties from the same school compete with you, and some must be faced in boss battles. Battles are turn-based. When training ends, the girls' abilities and achievements are judged, and the results decide the career each one goes on to.

女の子だって冒険したいっ！

「英雄」めざしてがんばる女の子たちの痛快ドタバタ新・育成ロープレ！
